summary: Iter19 — 14-day Free Trial + Apps & Add-ons discoverability fully verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 8/8 in /app/backend/tests/test_iter19_trial.py: register stamps trial_started_at/trial_ends_at(+14d)/subscription_status='trial'; lazy backfill on legacy users via /api/billing/my-subscription; active subscription overrides (on_trial=false, read_only=false, trial_days_left=null); day-10 reminder lazy fire when trial_days_left<=4 (idempotent — second call did NOT re-stamp or re-emit notification, in-app notification with type='trial_ending_soon' inserted, RESEND_API_KEY absent so detail=no_resend_key as expected MOCKED); trial_gate middleware returns 402 + {detail, trial_expired:true} on POST /api/workers when trial expired with no active sub, GET /api/workers still 200, /api/billing/preview POST allow-listed (not 402); active subscription bypass verified with worker creation succeeding when trial_ends_at is past but tier=pro+status=active. Iter18 regression suite re-run 18/18 still passing. Frontend verified live on owner@safetradie.demo via Playwright on the public preview URL: trial-active-banner with 'FREE TRIAL · 14 DAYS LEFT' eyebrow + Sparkle icon + 'Choose a plan' CTA + dismiss-x — dismiss correctly sets localStorage.trial_banner_dismissed_v1='1', removes banner, and persists across reload; apps-addons-section grid renders all 4 apps-card-{tradeinduct,tradecheck,academy,mobile-worker} cards with apps-trial-pill 'ALL UNLOCKED IN TRIAL' yellow chip; sidebar shows 'APPS & ADD-ONS' yellow eyebrow with all 7 nav-app-* items (tradeinduct/tradecheck/academy/partner-portal/automations/webhooks/mobile-worker) above SAFETY section, old 'ECOSYSTEM' label gone; clicking apps-card-tradeinduct correctly navigates to /dashboard/tradeinduct (zero-gating verified). Expired-trial path tested via direct Mongo expiry of owner: trial-expired-banner appeared with 'READ-ONLY MODE — TRIAL ENDED' label + 'Choose plan' CTA, trial-active-banner hidden, GET /dashboard/workers still loaded fine, fetch POST /api/workers returned 402 (visible in browser console error log). Owner trial state restored after testing.

critical_code_review_comments: trial_gate middleware: token decode duplicates get_current_user logic — extract a shared helper async def _resolve_user_from_request(request) -> Optional[dict] to keep middleware + dependency in lockstep on auth conventions.
_compute_trial: ceil-days math uses (seconds_left + 86399) // 86400 — correct for positive days but redundant max(0, ...) clamp since seconds_left>0 guarantees positive ceil. Minor.

_maybe_send_trial_reminder: stamps trial_reminder_sent_at + creates notification even when RESEND_API_KEY missing (delivered_via='in_app_only') — this is a deliberate MOCKED behavior and aligns with the spec. Confirmed in test_day10_reminder_lazy_and_idempotent.
register endpoint hardcodes +14d directly (line 234) while my-subscription path uses TRIAL_LENGTH_DAYS constant — pull the constant up so register/google-session reuse it (avoid drift).
trial_gate middleware silently returns call_next on user-not-found / parse-error — correct for downstream 401 handling but worth a debug log for observability.
Allow-list /api/notifications matches both reads + writes — fine since notifications are user-scoped and trivial; document the rationale in code comment.
Frontend useTier hook + Dashboard.jsx + DashboardLayout.jsx — clean implementation; localStorage dismissal key is versioned ('_v1') which is a nice future-proof touch.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (banner show/dismiss/persist, expired banner, apps section, sidebar nav, route navigation, 402 on write all verified)
